headline: Economic development strategic plan work session on how to tell the story to the community, plus working group reports.
summary: Discussion covers how to share the strategic plan with the public and its rollout. Three working groups will report on innovation and aviation, hospitality, and permit expediting.
items: Public comment on topics not on the agenda
Updates from the chair and staff, plus committee and council updates
Work session on how to tell the story to the community, including the communicating plan and rollout
Working group reports on the innovation district and aviation sector, hospitality and destination, and permit expediting and concierge permitting
location: South Burlington City Hall, 180 Market Street, 3rd Floor, Room 301
